notes.title: Third big bug fix and new achievements!
Anvil Saga is out! Update your game and get to work!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

The day has finally come: Anvil Saga is now complete and ready for you to play – we are extremely excited to finally share the game in its entirety with you!

Please note that since there is new content added to all three chapters of the game, your old save files will not be compatible with it. You will need to start a new game to experience all of the new content. Sorry!

[previewyoutube=jSn2Nvg255w;full][/previewyoutube]

In this update, the choices you make will affect the outcome of your story, influencing the fates of every character in Anvil Saga. Who will become the greatest blacksmith in the land, Arthur or Jean-Jacues? Who will win the hand of the fair maiden Olivia? Will the Baron remain the most powerful man in the province? You decide these and many more.

Unfortunately, we will need a little more time to prepare quality translations into Korean and Japanese. Therefore, they will be added to the game at a later date.

Update Anvil Saga and share your thoughts and impressions here or on our official Discord.


Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: Additional bugfix of the latest update
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

We've fixed fresh bugs from the last update and added something new.

What's new:

 Added outline around the worker pool refresh button in case the player can refresh it for free thanks to a bonus from the English. 
 Now, customers’ order wait time is not reduced while playing a request to place an order on loan. 

Bug fixes: 

 Memory leaks and FPS drops when playing for long periods of time.
 Bug with clicking through the interface while changing the room design if there was another room under the interface.
 Bug with the failure dialog of making a mallet for Vlad ("VladThirdFail" was shown instead of texts).
 Bug with the disappearance of shields from both the mercenaries’ additional order and from the story order of England/France in case of failure of one of the orders (previously, instead of failure of one order, both orders failed at once).
 Bug when sometimes Antonio asked to make 0 items for the faction.
 Bug with overlaying the quest interface on the blacksmith interface in the lower-left corner. Now only 3 or 4 quests are shown at the same time, depending on the screen resolution. We plan to add quest scrolling in a future patch. At the moment, all quests, if there are more than 3 or 4 of them, can be viewed through the journal.
 Bug in the sandbox, because of which the first pool of workers in the hiring menu was always empty (0 available workers before clicking on the refresh button).
 Bug with the first bonus of the English faction not working.  Instead of providing the opportunity to refresh the pool of workers once a day for free, the "bonus" took off 50 coins instead of 25, and also incorrectly showed the cost of updating the pool: 0 instead of 25, even if the bonus was not ready to use.
 A bug when selling a log rack caused the number of logs available to not decrease.
 The font size in the hiring menu is now dynamic; the worker's name doesn't go outside the window. 
 Bug with transferring workers to the fair along with food.
 Bug with Vlad not ordering anything during the "Christmas" modifier. 
 Unique customers getting stuck during the "Christmas" modifier. 
 Conditions for getting the "A too-strict fast" achievement.

UPDATE:
We have also fixed the following bugs in the game: 

 Bug where loading a save made right before the fair would skip the fair. 
 Bug causing the interface to disable when accepting a bulk order.
 Bug where after fulfilling or failing Antonio's bulk orders, items were sometimes left in the order feed. 
 Bug where Antonio's bulk orders would sometimes show a bed texture instead of the desired item.
 Bug with displaying incorrect blacksmith portraits in some dialogs.
 Bug with displaying a bed texture instead of a ratchet at the first fair.
 Bug with the non-localized key "GlobaOrderChurchFail".
 Bug that could cause King Arthur to come to the player with the second quest BEFORE the first quest in the sandbox.
 A small visual bug where the witch sometimes played the animation of the village headman during dialogs.
 An interface bug that caused one underground room to show cells for a roof type.
 Bug where a customer could offer zero wood in exchange for an order.
 Bug with customers getting stuck during the "Christmas" modifier.
 Interface bug with room customization.
 Now, when moving the camera to a room and clicking on the exclamation mark, the interface does not get cropped as before.

We’ve also added lighting to all ground-floor rooms. Torches light up at night and go out in the morning.

Thank you for supporting the game and letting us know about any bugs that are discovered. Our small team really appreciates it.

Regards, 
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: The new Anvil Saga update is available now!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

We are releasing a new update with a number of important changes and bug fixes for Anvil Saga.

First of all, Arthur can no longer obtain the "Pacifist" trait. This has been requested by the warlike players since the game was first released – if you're one of them, let us know in the comments below.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_2fb0c47fc3fe45a081e9fb27223a94a1~mv2.gif

The order feed's priority list has been changed. Now there can be only one order with a certain priority, instead of several. For example, only a single order with a priority of "1", "2", "3", etc. We also added the ability to drag and drop order cards. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/c8015ce1a84cc8f08fced9eac4a574305389e7d2.png

Improved the mechanics of equipping workers. Each blacksmith has a pool of three items and will automatically switch between them for the most efficient work completion on a particular machine. The equipment interface has also been redesigned specifically for this mechanic. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/7af97ab1ad23db1c58ec89daed76d3435a238351.png

The workers' remuneration was overhauled to appear in a separate window, similar to the tax payment system. A worker's mood will decrease if you refuse to pay them.

A worker's speed will be directly influenced by their mood; characters who are not a part of the plot will leave the forge if they are in a terrible mood. You will need to keep an eye on your budget to ensure that the forge doesn't go bankrupt.

There are also small improvements to the visuals and sound design, such as animated birds appearing in the background and sound effects when changing the appearance of a room.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_c72019ed476b461bba0273fa9f9631a6~mv2.gif

In addition to the major interface changes, we have also added several small improvements: 

 The store will alert you if you do not have enough space for food or resources.
 The amount of food will appear when you hover your cursor over a cupboard.
 Wood has been moved to a separate category in the store. 
 Items from Antonio's shop have been added to the order feed. 

Fixed bugs:

 Bug with Oscar's tutorial.
 Bug with displaying Olivia's order for tools.
 Bug with the debuff of bandits.
 Bug with gaining experience from sharpening on the sharpening stone.
 Bug with bandits taking away Arthur's winnings after the first fair.
 Bug with chronologically incorrect arrival of Arthur the impostor in the sandbox. 
 Bug with Vlad coming to the forge several times a day. Now he can only come to the forge once a day. 
 Bug where customers who had already placed an order left when the counter closed.
 

Other than that: 

 Revamped the prestige system. Every 5 points of prestige, the cost of orders is increased by 1% up to a total cost of 150%. 
 Increased the speed of spawning customers by 30%. Also, if a monk is spawned, with a probability of 70% the game will spawn a witch, and vice versa.
 Added the ability for the player to accept story orders that require wood, even if the player does not have a workbench. 
 Increased the capacity of log racks. 
 Fixed prices for logs. 
 Fixed the conditions for building the bottom left room in the mine.
 Added new achievements!

Thank you to everyone for supporting Anvil Saga! Please share your impressions of the game here or in our Discord. We read all of the feedback and constantly try to improve the game for you.

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: The Long-awaited Anvil Saga Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

The new update is live, and it is full of great stuff.

First of all, we added almost all of the contester's customers to the game, and only one is remaining. 

The second important thing is we finally fixed the annoying ‘Small-town celebrations’ bug. Now the shop works properly, the courier will deliver goods, and your workers will not have to starve, get sick, and eat the underground mushrooms. 

Notice: all your saves in the story mode are compatible with the new Update only until day 20. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/8bb2fbeb396e5aead94ebf0fd854a957dfcbe5b6.png

Here’s the list of new stuff the Update has to offer:  

 Scholars, a new customer type, with which you are already familiar from our previous spotlight. 
 The Second Fair that’ll allow you to show your woodcraft mastery. 
 Special new customers: Death, Doctor What, Doctor Where, Doctor When, Wise Old Man, Sullen Swordsman, Adventure Sicker. 
 Some new faces and the bulk orderers you are familiar with: Gobin, Doan J’Ark, Vlad, Gnomes, Ragnar, King Arthur… and True King Arthur? Hmmm, quite an intrigue right here, it is time to dip into the game to see where it will lead.
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/cade8eec18274a55d3ecf84d5fd6f59ec678038d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/6a2d7ed99cabcaa40c0bd578d2cf75245c05b0ef.png

Improved Visuals:

 The houses and tents are now in the tutorial’s and the fair’s background. 
 Improved weather effects - dusks and dawns are added to the game.
 Migratory birds are flying in the sky.

Also, we put some gameplay changes: now the workshop requires only a grindstone OR a workbench, and you don’t need two have them both for it. And pay attention cause a workbench MUST be placed at the workshop.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_99b37bd7ea29419c80849a8d1dc02b51~mv2.gif

Furthermore the ‘Courier’ bug, we applied some other fixes: 

 Bugs with completion and acceptance of bulk orders. 
 Incorrect bulk orders counter.
 The bug when fraction skills weren’t applied to the taxman.
 The interface disappearance after or during certain events. 
 Some sharpening quests are redesigned. 
 The blocker after not completing the Baron’s order on the fifth day. 
 The hunters and soldiers freezing during the  winter modifier applied.
 A bunch of incorrectly displayed system texts on journal, events, and dialogues.
 An incorrect display of order signs after a restart.
 Some of the quests didn’t require players to buy stuff from Antonio’s Store when they should.
 
Thanks for all your support, comments, and suggestions, those are truly inspiring and help us to move further. Play and share your thoughts about new stuff, your ideas, and your experiences on our Discord. 

Regards, 
The Anvil Saga Team

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/ca478c58c554ec36b36265fca252003904573b14.png

notes.title: Anvil Saga update 0.8 is out! Play now!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

We're excited to announce that the latest update for Anvil Saga is out! Hurry and update your game so that you can enjoy all of the new content.

What's new: 

 The Fall and Winter seasons have been added, along with eight new modifiers: Beaujolais Day, Foliage Cleaning, Valentine's Day, Halloween, Christmas, Eclipse, Frosty Snowmen, Blizzard. 
 Wood and mixed iron orders are now available. You'll have to masterfully fulfill these to make your customers happy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/e39e68e775558e44aabb617d44553e4f42cb828b.png

 There are new items for the blacksmith store to help you complete the woodworking orders: sawhorse, sawmill, workbench.
 Employees have new perks related to carpentry. For example, “Sawing expert”, “Passionate carpenter”, etc.
 You can now build a new level of the forge and decorate it with new items.
 We've added new tools for the store. Arthur and his apprentices can now add Ultra Heat-Resistant Tongs, a Sharp Saw, a Great Grindstone, and more to their blacksmithing and carpentry arsenal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/2023bb69add506a435154bc332381e9217655007.png

 Four new complex customers will visit Arthur. Their identities will be kept a secret for now, so you'll have to play through the new update to uncover who they are.
 Arthur doesn't know how to properly work with wood. Fear not, because Sir Philipp will teach him (and the player) the art of working with timber to fulfill wood and mixed orders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/f890c3f6d826f353270558e7bcb2043bbff829b5.png
In addition to all of the new stuff, we have also re-balanced all normal orders, fixed several bugs, and added a new losing condition: having your reputation drop to zero with the ruling faction.

Your old save files are compatible with the new update, so you can pick up where you left off. However, if your ruling faction reputation was already at zero, you will immediately lose.

Moreover, when you load an old save, the chests can turn into food cupboards. Sometimes the forge is a bit like Hogwarts. 

Unfortunately, we have not yet been able to reproduce and fix the following problem: when loading the 20-day save in the story mode, the game may freeze and stop responding in some cases. And, during the Refugee event, the quest doesn’t show up as completed in the list sometimes. 

We are already working on a solution to all these problems and hope to fix them soon.  

Update the game, enjoy the noble art of blacksmithing and carpentry, and please share your impressions with us on Discord and the Steam Discussion boards.

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: Try the new Anvil Saga beta update before anyone else!

Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

We have some hot news for you: the beta 0.8 update of Anvil Saga is now available on Steam. For those who wish to, you can play it now before it's officially released.

We have added new carpentry mechanics, new complex customers, two seasons (fall and winter), eight new modifiers, additional tools and furniture for your blacksmith shop, as well as a new losing mechanic. Updates are available both for the story mode and sandbox mode, but the next part of the story is still in the works.  

The old saves are valid, and you can pick up where you left off. But be careful: if at the moment of saving you had zero reputation with the ruling faction, you will lose immediately. But you will see a new game over illustration. There is an upside to everything.

notes.title: Update 0.5 is out!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

The latest update for Anvil Saga is now available and ready for download! We've added the content that we promised you in the roadmap, along with changes based on comments from the community. Here's what's in store for you.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40267025/249093ce41a35a5d135a29e33b1279e9d4ad4c25.png
New added content:

 The Fair – the finale of the first chapter.
 New complex orders for customers.
 New side quests.
 12 new perks for the forge workers.


Improvements and fixes: 

 Changed the scale of the highlighted worker icon. Previously, it was smaller than other icons, and is now larger than them. 
 The number of available workers is now displayed on the hiring screen. 
 Added a display for raw materials that are still required for an order above the corresponding workbench. For example, if you run out of ingots or ore, a crossed out icon with the resource will always hang above the anvil, with ore above the furnace, and so on.
 Added the ability to switch between workers in the equipment interface.
 Added the ability to move furniture between rooms.
 Tuned up the mechanics of orders and reputation:
 Orders that require a book to study will only appear from the second level of the counter.
 If a representative of one faction comes to you, and you are already working on an order from their opposition, the new customer does not leave before he gets in line. You have the option to choose which faction's order to fulfill.
 Fulfilling orders from peasants does not affect reputation.
 Reputation from the warriors reduced to 1.
 Revised the prices of orders for different types of customers.
 Possible workers will now include characters with a different appearance to those the player already has. 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40267025/6ecbddcc3a2db3ace343584391d93e44beda6159.png
Other:

 Removed the ingot smelting from the tutorial.
 Installed the dynamic price of rooms – first cheaper, then more expensive.
 You can now see the second customer without the camera moving in the tutorial.


Please note that the beta-branch is now closed. Thank you all for testing!

Launch Steam to update the game to the latest version. We look forward to seeing you in Steam Discussions and on our Discord. Feel free to ask us questions, leave comments, and let us know what you think of Anvil Saga. 

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: Another Hotfix, Hotter Than the Last One
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

We forged a new update that fixes a slew of bugs. We will continue collecting your feedback and bug reports. Thank you for being so active and sharing your experience!

IMPORTANT: While saves from previous versions must be compatible, most of the save bugs will persist on old saves.

List of fixed bugs:

 Bandit customers getting stuck.
 Customers that ask the player to fulfill orders for a loan or in exchange for food get stuck after the game loads.
 Special customers arrive again after the game loads.
 A second beggar arrives after the game loads.
 A builder getting stuck on the stairs.
 Spoiled food turning fresh after being picked up and put back on the table. 
 The Baron's assistant leaving with Antonio.
 Ore could be placed into any piece of furniture.
 Infinite order fulfillment and gold after reloading.
 Players unable to sell food cabinets and bookcases (if they are empty).
 Game UI disappears when special customers arrive again.
 A “phantom” order is created after the game loads.
 Anotonio’s order wouldn’t save after reloading
 Scheduled events wouldn’t save after reloading
 Double cooking meals
 Endless day bug 
 Unique customers forgetting their orders after reloading
 You could send workers underground (through textures)
 A “phantom” worker in bed after reloading
 Invisible buttons in some pages of the journal
 “Protagonist” trait appearing on hired workers
 Faction changing bug after reloading
 Food could be gotten from a mine
 A doctor wouldn't arrive after reloading 
 Arthur’s and workers’ sprites swapping after reloading
 Improved pathfinding when searching for objects
 Some workers’ words wouldn’t go away after reloading
 Special customers wouldn’t go away after reloading
 Slapping animation blocker in a certain plot moment
 Minor description mistakes 

Update the game, keep playing and share your gaming experience on our Discord server. Your help is invaluable!

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: Latest Hotfix Reverted!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

As it turned out, the latest hotfix was too hot. As a result, there was one bug that could block your progress, namely sometimes a day would not end. 
We are reverting the game to the previous build which has no known blockers, although some previous minor bugs will stay unfixed for now. We will test the current build again, hotfix the hotfix, and roll it back out soon! 

IMPORTANT: The reversion may result in incompatible save files. We will try to fix this problem in the future updates. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: Another Hotfix, Hot From the Forge
notes.notes:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

We forged a new update that fixes a slew of bugs. We will continue collecting your feedback and bug reports. Thank you for being so active and sharing your experience!

IMPORTANT: Installing the update and resuming your existing game session using old save files will not result in the bugs listed below being fixed. These bugs will be fixed only if you start a new game. Other than that, the old save files are compatible with the update and should not produce any issues.

List of fixed bugs:

 Bandit customers getting stuck.
 Customers that ask the player to fulfill orders for a loan or in exchange for food get stuck after the game loads.
 Special customers arrive again after the game loads.
 A second beggar arrives after the game loads.
 A builder getting stuck on the stairs.
 Spoiled food turning fresh after being picked up and put back on the table. 
 The Baron's assistant leaving with Antonio.
 Ore could be placed into any piece of furniture.
 Infinite order fulfillment and gold after reloading.
 Players unable to sell food cabinets and bookcases (if they are empty).
 Game UI disappears when special customers arrive again.
 A “phantom” order is created after the game loads.

Update the game, keep playing and share your gaming experience on our Discord server. Your help is invaluable!

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

Thank you so much for actively playing, finding bugs, and helping us. We forged this hotfix and brought it to you hot off the anvil. 

It's available in the test branch for now. To switch to a custom branch in the Steam client, right-click on the game from the library page and select "Properties". Among the available tabs, there will be the "BETAS" tab.

notes.title: Anvil Saga Forges Pre-release Demo for Guerrilla Collective
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

We forged a new demo for historically accurate-ish blacksmith simulator Anvil Saga for the Guerrilla Collective 3 digital event. So strike while the iron is hot and play it now!

The demo consists of a revamped tutorial, a prologue level, and the first 11 days of the story campaign. You'll get to know the ruler of the province, the eccentric baron, and Jean-Jacques Jr., your rival who aspires to win the hand of the baron's fair daughter.

Choose your side and help either the English or French armies, or betray both and work with bandits. Welcome a few unique customers, some of whom may seem strangely familiar and all of whom have bizarre requests for you. 

The game will be released into Steam Early Access on June 21, that’s really soon. Play, tell your friends, and don’t forget to share your feedback on Discord!

Regards,
Anvil Saga team
